notes: Unique respondent identifier; maps to person_id as the primary key for the person table.
Data release cycle is a survey metadata variable. Store as an observation with observation_concept_id representing 'Survey version' or similar. Concept_id depends on available vocabulary.

Interview/examination status is a study-specific attribute. Map to observation table. Concept_id for status categories (e.g., 'Interviewed only', 'Both interviewed and MEC examined') would need custom or existing concepts.
Gender of participant. Map code 1 (Male) to 8507, code 2 (Female) to 8532. Missing values map to 0.
Age in years at screening. Calculate year_of_birth as (year of screening - RIDAGEYR). For top-coded 80, use 80. Missing values require imputation or leave null.
Age in months for persons <=24 months. Can be used to refine year_of_birth or stored as an observation with concept for 'Age in months'.

Race/Hispanic origin recode. This variable combines race and ethnicity. Map Hispanic categories (1,2) to ethnicity_concept_id (Hispanic/Latino = 38003563). Non-Hispanic categories (3,4,5) map to 38003564 (Not Hispanic). Race details from this variable are less granular; use RIDRETH3 for race.

Race/Hispanic origin with NH Asian. Map race categories: 1 (Mexican American) -> 0 (Hispanic ethnicity handled separately), 2 (Other Hispanic) -> 0, 3 (Non-Hispanic White) -> 8527 (White), 4 (Non-Hispanic Black) -> 8516 (Black or African American), 6 (Non-Hispanic Asian) -> 8515 (Asian). Multi-racial from RIDRETH1 code 5 may map to 0 or multiple race concepts.
Six-month time period of exam. Map to observation with concept for 'Season of examination' (e.g., November-April = 1, May-October = 2).
Age in months at exam for <=19 years. Store as observation with concept for 'Age in months at examination'.
Served active duty in US Armed Forces. Map to observation with concept for 'Military service history'. Yes/No/Refused/Don't know map to standard concepts (e.g., Yes=4188539, No=4188540).
Country of birth. Code 1 (Born in 50 US states or Washington, DC) maps to concept for 'United States'. Code 2 (Others) maps to a generic 'Foreign born' concept. Refused/Don't know map to 0.
Length of time in US. Map to observation with concept for 'Length of residence in US'. Categories (Less than 1 year, 1-4 years, etc.) map to ordinal concepts.
Education level - Adults 20+. Map to observation with concept for 'Education level'. Standard concepts exist (e.g., Less than 9th grade, High school graduate, College graduate).
Marital status. Map to observation with concept for 'Marital status'. Standard concepts: Married/Living with partner, Widowed/Divorced/Separated, Never married.
Pregnancy status at exam. Map to observation with concept for 'Pregnancy status'. Positive/Not pregnant/Cannot ascertain map to standard concepts.
Total number of people in the Household. Map to observation with concept for 'Household size'. Numeric value stored as value_as_number.
HH reference person's gender. Map to observation with concept for 'Gender of household reference person'. Male/Female map to 8507/8532.
HH reference person's age category. Map to observation with concept for 'Age category of household reference person'. Categories (<20, 20-39, 40-59, 60+) map to ordinal concepts.
HH reference person's education level. Map to observation with concept for 'Education level of household reference person'. Categories map to standard education concepts.
HH reference person's marital status. Map to observation with concept for 'Marital status of household reference person'. Categories map to standard marital status concepts.
HH reference person's spouse's education level. Map to observation with concept for 'Education level of spouse of household reference person'.
Full sample 2-year interview weight. Survey weights are stored in observation table with concept for 'Survey weight'.
Full sample 2-year MEC exam weight. Survey weight for examined participants. Store in observation table.
Masked variance pseudo-stratum. Design variable for variance estimation. Store as observation with concept for 'Survey design stratum'.
Masked variance pseudo-PSU. Design variable for variance estimation. Store as observation with concept for 'Survey design PSU'.
Ratio of family income to poverty. Map to observation with concept for 'Income to poverty ratio'. Numeric value stored as value_as_number; top-coded value 5 can be stored as 5.
